title: IF Your Fuzz-Monster Is NOT Ruff On Toys...
text:
I took BarkBox for about 6 months. Got excellent customer service and could see spending the $20 on toys and treats in the store so it was a good value for a Med size dog. I almost canceled after the first 3 boxes because the dog was ripping the toys apart in the first 3 days. I called them and they put her on a heavy chewer box. They lasted longer, about 2 weeks, then they were toast too.
The quality of the toys kept going down and so I did cancel. HOWEVER. If your dog is not too hard on toys, it was delightful to have every month.
WARNING! My UPS guy just now delivered a box of what I know to be files. It has been almost a year since my dog last got a BarkBox. She STILL thinks he is bringing her something and is very disappointed when he does not. SO- if your just trying the service, don't open the box in front of your dog until you know your going to continue.
UPDATE: IT HAS BEEN 2 YEARS SINCE THE LAST BARKBOX..Y DOG STILL MORNS WHEN DELIVERIES ARE NOT FOR HER!
You might want to consider not starting this dangerous and devistating addiction!
label: negative
